review_views.label: 全体構図
review_views.evidence: Base, raw, protected final, guide, edit mask, and protection mask were inspected at original detail.
review_views.notes: The two main mountain fields are visible, but they read as oblique scenic mountain glyphs rather than horizontal relief.

review_views.label: 原寸100%
review_views.evidence: The 1536x1024 final was inspected at native scale.
review_views.notes: Triangular summits and dark side faces are already conspicuous; four detached foothills are not reliably readable.

review_views.label: 200%・400%拡大
review_views.evidence: All thirteen images in tmp/map-production/g1-review-v1 were inspected at original detail.
review_views.notes: Enlargement exposes repeated comb hachures, polygon clipping, road-protection cavities, and vertical-looking faces.

review_views.label: 中央・四隅・四辺の9領域
review_views.evidence: The full base/final pair and amplified difference were scanned across the complete canvas.
review_views.notes: Protected geography is stable; generated relief reaches the east and south canvas edges.

review_views.label: 制御図との半透明重ね合わせ
review_views.evidence: The topology guide, edit mask, protection mask, and 8x difference were compared.
review_views.notes: The difference retains guide polygon vertices and large road/detail holes rather than six natural landforms.

review_views.label: 親ズーム画像との比較
review_views.evidence: Candidate D v4 was compared with G1 raw and protected final at matching coordinates.
review_views.notes: Base color and protected features continue, but the mountain rendering introduces a local perspective and density jump.

review_views.label: 四方向の隣接合成
review_views.evidence: North-east, south-east, and edge crops were checked at 200% and 400%.
review_views.notes: Relief is clipped at the north-east right edge and south-east bottom/right edges, so neighbor continuity is not established.

review_views.label: ベクターラベル・道路・POI重畳
review_views.evidence: Road guards, city wall, fields, trees, water, and quiet-space requirements were reviewed.
review_views.notes: Road pixels remain exact, but dense dark mountain faces compete with future labels and POIs.

review_views.label: Leafletデスクトップ表示
review_views.evidence: The style candidate was assessed against the desktop raster/vector hierarchy; it was not staged because hard failures were visible before publication.
review_views.notes: The perspective jump would remain visible at ordinary desktop scale.

review_views.label: Leafletモバイル表示
review_views.evidence: The native overview was assessed at reduced visual scale; it was not staged because the candidate failed the image gate.
review_views.notes: Main massifs dominate while the required detached foothills disappear.

immediate_failures.label: 海岸線・河川・主要道路・城壁の移動
immediate_failures.evidence: The protected composite reports zero changed pixels for outside permission, road core, detail core, and zero mask; visual inspection agrees.

immediate_failures.label: 必須地点・地形の欠落
immediate_failures.evidence: The quiet saddles and all four detached foothill roles fail to remain readable at 100%, 200%, and 400%.

immediate_failures.label: 正典外の主要都市・施設
immediate_failures.evidence: No new city, facility, road, or major landmark is present in the protected result.

immediate_failures.label: AI生成文字・記号
immediate_failures.evidence: No letters, pseudo-writing, legend, compass, scale bar, or route-like generated text was found.

immediate_failures.label: 目視できる継ぎ目
immediate_failures.evidence: Guide polygon corners, road/detail cavities, and relief clipped at the east and south canvas edges are visible in native and enlarged views.

immediate_failures.label: 現代物・透かし・署名
immediate_failures.evidence: No modern object, watermark, logo, or signature was found.

immediate_failures.label: 遠近法化・縮尺の急変
immediate_failures.evidence: North-east and south-east relief uses triangular summits, dark side faces, and scenic vertical-looking mountain silhouettes.

immediate_failures.label: 建物・樹木・岩の不自然な反復
immediate_failures.evidence: Repeated triangular peaks and comb-like parallel hachures occur across both mountain fields.

scores.label: 正典・地形形状との一致
scores.notes: Protected geography is stable, but required saddles and four foothill landforms are absent as readable hierarchy.

scores.label: 親子ズームの連続性
scores.notes: Base palette and major features continue, while the oblique mountain language separates the edited regions from the parent.

scores.label: 隣接画像の継ぎ目
scores.notes: Polygon boundaries, protection holes, and south/east clipping remain visible.

scores.label: 画風・色・線密度
scores.notes: The engraving palette is close, but side-view summits and dark faces violate the horizontal map-plane style.

scores.label: 縮尺相応の情報量
scores.notes: Main massifs are over-dense while foothills are too faint, producing an unstable information hierarchy.

scores.label: 生成破綻・反復模様
scores.notes: Repeated peaks, parallel hachures, protection cavities, and clipping remain despite the absence of generated text.

scores.label: ベクター重畳時の可読性
scores.notes: Roads are exact, but dense high-contrast mountain faces compete with labels and POIs.

summary: Candidate G1 proves the guide-derived protection composite but fails the Golden style gate. Both mountain fields use oblique triangular scenic glyphs, required saddles and foothills are unreadable, and guide/canvas clipping remains visible.
required_changes: Replace side-view mountain symbols with low-relief, strictly orthographic topographic hachures on the horizontal map plane.
Use six smooth, fully in-canvas landform footprints with readable detached foothills and open saddles; prevent guide edges and road guards from reading as holes.
